method: Native CPU from32 original recorded poses/velocities/friction, no IK reset. Withdraw30mm outward+30mm up0.5s, lower outside0.5s, side approach0.5s, press/climb1s per recorded segment, hold0.5s. Explicit waypoint positions/times recorded per case. Original fingers; after first20/40mm climb, apply each reported wrist angle around worldY in1s at fixed hand target, then another20/40mm climb in1s. Same first segment and bounds/friction; wrist commands are diagnostic only, bounded native joint-position controls with static gravity compensation. Wrenches every20ms; positive20deg+wall contact is a mechanism diagnostic, not RL success. No policy supervision or model change.
